_comment: Nissan Patrol Y63, Australian spec, right-hand drive. Coming soon. Re-run this brief against staging/production to recreate the page there: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/create-car-page.mjs scripts/briefs/nissan-patrol-y63.json --publish. Sources: nissan.com.au all-new-patrol (grade equipment, colours, engine, towing), CarExpert (Australian launch timing). Images are Nissan Australia press shots of a pre-production car, stored under public/cars/nissan-patrol-y63/.
upholstery: Synthetic leather on Ti, Ti+ and Ti-L; genuine leather-accented on Ti-L Reserve
infotainment: Dual 12.3-inch displays on Ti and Ti+, dual 14.3-inch on Ti-L and Ti-L Reserve, NissanConnect with Google built-in

grades.name: Ti
grades.summary: The entry to the range, and already the full dual-range four-wheel-drive hardware.
highlights: 3D fixed Intelligent Around View Monitor with invisible hood "skeleton view"
Synthetic leather seats and leather-accented steering wheel
Four-wheel drive with dual-range interlocking transfer case (4H & 4L)
NissanConnect connected car services with Google built-in

grades.name: Ti+
grades.summary: Ti equipment, plus the glass roof and the load-and-go hardware.
highlights: Tilt and slide power sunroof with panoramic glass roof
Privacy glass (second row and rear windows)

grades.name: Ti-L
grades.summary: Bigger screens, Klipsch audio and adaptive damping on 20-inch wheels.
highlights: 3D rotation Intelligent Around View Monitor with skeleton view hood

grades.name: Ti-L Reserve
grades.summary: The flagship: air suspension, 22-inch wheels and a second row that gets its own screens.
highlights: Air suspension and eDamper electric shock absorber
Driver and passenger front massage seats

valuePoints.title: You buy at the Australian price, not a re-exporter's
valuePoints.description: Australia is one of the seven countries our own team buys in. You order the Patrol through the Australian retail network at the Australian price, and the margin a re-exporter would take on the way out stays with you.

valuePoints.title: One landed number, before you commit
valuePoints.description: When Nissan confirms Australian pricing we map the duty, VAT and registration-tax position for your destination and give you a single landed figure with the freight in it. You decide on the real number, not an estimate.

valuePoints.title: Right-hand drive, with the file to prove it
valuePoints.description: Our Australian office clears the car for export and prepares the pack your own authority asks for — build date, VIN, compliance and the exact grade specification — and we support your clearance at the destination port.

notes: The Y63 Patrol drops the V8 for a 317 kW twin-turbo V6 — order it in Australian spec, right-hand drive, in Ti, Ti+, Ti-L or Ti-L Reserve. It is the same 3.5-litre engine and nine-speed automatic in all of them, on a dual-range transfer case and rated to tow 3.7 tonnes braked, so the ladder from Ti to Ti-L Reserve is about wheels, screens and suspension rather than what is under the bonnet. Pick a grade above and the specification below follows it. Australia is one of the seven countries we buy in, so you can order this one at Australian retail and ship it to your own market. Register your interest and we will come back with a landed cost for your country once Nissan confirms Australian pricing. Photography is Nissan Australia press imagery of a pre-production car; Nissan states that Australian specifications, features, design elements and availability are subject to change without notice.
